title: System Identification & Inventory
expected: Standard Linux OS, supported kernel, identified init and log system
remediation: Review system inventory periodically to track supported OS and kernel versions.
references: CIS Linux Benchmark - System Accounting and Identification

title: Ensure UID 0 is Assigned Only to Root
remediation: Remove any secondary or rogue accounts with UID 0 in /etc/passwd or change their UID to a standard non-zero value.
references: CIS Linux Benchmark: Ensure root is the only UID 0 account

title: Ensure No Accounts Have Empty Password Fields
expected: No active accounts possess empty password hashes in /etc/shadow
remediation: Lock empty accounts using 'passwd -l <user>' or set a strong password using 'passwd <user>'.
references: CIS Linux Benchmark: Ensure password fields are not empty

title: Verify Password Ageing Configuration
remediation: Edit /etc/login.defs to enforce PASS_MAX_DAYS 90 and PASS_MIN_DAYS 1.
references: CIS Linux Benchmark: Ensure password expiration is configured

title: Verify Core Account File Permissions (/etc/passwd, /etc/group)
expected: Mode 0644 or more restrictive, owned by root:root
references: CIS Linux Benchmark: Permissions on /etc/passwd and /etc/group

title: Verify Shadow File Permissions (/etc/shadow)
expected: Mode 0640 or 0600, owned by root:root or root:shadow
remediation: Run 'chmod 600 /etc/shadow' (or 640 if shadow group is used) and 'chown root:root /etc/shadow'.

title: Ensure Direct SSH Root Login is Disabled
remediation: Set 'PermitRootLogin no' in /etc/ssh/sshd_config (or /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/), validate with 'sshd -t', and reload sshd.
references: CIS Linux Benchmark: Ensure SSH root login is disabled

title: Ensure SSH Password Authentication is Disabled
remediation: Set 'PasswordAuthentication no' in /etc/ssh/sshd_config (or sshd_config.d/), ensure public key authentication is configured, validate with 'sshd -t', and reload sshd.
references: CIS Linux Benchmark: Ensure SSH PasswordAuthentication is disabled

title: Inspect Listening Network Ports & Services
expected: Only authorized listening TCP/UDP sockets and known services
remediation: Review listening sockets with 'ss -tulpen' or 'netstat' and stop/disable unneeded background services using the platform service manager.
references: CIS Linux Benchmark: Ensure unnecessary services are disabled

title: Detect Firewall Tool and Active Enforcement State
expected: An active firewall enforcement service (e.g. ufw active, firewalld running, or active nft/iptables rulesets)
remediation: Enable and configure a supported firewall tool (e.g. 'ufw enable' or enable nftables / firewalld) ensuring SSH remains allowed.
references: CIS Linux Benchmark: Ensure a firewall is installed and active

title: Inspect Authentication Log for Failed Login Attempts
expected: Recent failed logins identified or healthy log baseline
remediation: Investigate recurring failed login sources and consider deploying Fail2ban or SSH rate limiting.
references: CIS Linux Benchmark: Monitor authentication logs and audit failures

title: Inspect Authentication Log for Successful Logins
expected: Recent authorized login events captured for accountability
remediation: Verify all identified successful logins correspond to approved users and scheduled maintenance windows.
references: CIS Linux Benchmark: Account log tracking and session audit
